input.encoding: Each node is [signed value, left child index, right child index]; -1 means absent.
input.root_index: The root can have any table index; an empty tree uses -1.
input.tree_requirement: A strict BST with unique values, every node reachable exactly once from the root, or the empty tree. Values are from -100000 through 100000.
input.next_semantics: The iterator reports hasNext=true and returns each value in ascending in-order order, then reports hasNext=false.
input.result: Order-sensitive checksum: sum((one_based_next_index) * (next_value + 100001)). An empty tree returns 0.
